response.query: How many participants/teams are required (formal power/sample-size calculations) to detect expected main, mediation, and interaction effects in lab and field studies?
response.answer: To detect main, mediation, and interaction effects, typically 10-20 participants per group are needed in lab studies, and 50-100 in field studies, depending on effect size and power desired.

results.title: Best Oracle Course in Chennai With 100% Placement Support
results.content: Through hands-on, practical projects, you will gain expertise in Oracle SQL, PL/SQL, Database Administration, Performance Tuning, Backup & Recovery and Data Security. * **Hands-on Learning Experience** – Offline Oracle courses provide direct interaction with trainers and lab sessions, allowing learners to practice SQL, PL/SQL and database administration in real-time. * **Versatility Across Job Roles**– Oracle skills to diverse remote job opportunities including DBA, PL/SQL Developer, ERP Consultant or Cloud Database Specialist. Oracle Training in Chennai offers comprehensive learning in Oracle Database concepts, SQL, PL/SQL, administration, and real-time project execution. The training covers Oracle Database, SQL, PL/SQL, Oracle Apps (ERP/HCM), Oracle Cloud, data modeling, performance tuning, backup and recovery and reporting tools like Oracle BI and APEX. These projects involve database design, PL/SQL programming, Oracle application implementation and report/dashboard creation to provide hands-on practical experience. Oracle training primarily focuses on backend skills, database management, PL/SQL and enterprise applications.
